Copied from the task's verified module cache on 2026-10-21. No Git history
was copied, the module cache was not modified, and upstream LICENSE
(MPL-2.0) is retained. This is an upstream compatibility component, not
recovered original Soga source.

Local changes:
- WaitReadCloser synchronizes response-body publication, cancellation and
  ownership; late bodies are closed and blocked reads wake on cancellation.
- Upload queue uses cancellation before waiting for writers, synchronizes
  active-body handoff, serializes heap reads, and closes queued bodies once.
  Closing a full queue now releases blocked producers instead of deadlocking.
- uploadWriter records buffer lengths before ownership transfers to the pipe,
  and releases still-unsubmitted buffers on failure. This removes a race with
  the consumer clearing or releasing the already-transferred buffer.
- DefaultDialerClient closed flag uses atomic.Bool across HTTP workers.
- VLESS Vision inbound and outbound retain base pointers as unsafe.Pointer
  and use unsafe.Add for field offsets. This preserves pointer provenance
  under Go's checkptr instrumentation instead of converting through a stored
  uintptr. No checkptr or race checks are disabled.
- concurrency_regression_test.go exercises response publication, cancellation,
  racing Set/Read/Close, queue cancellation, reader ownership, and partial
  out-of-order packet reassembly.
- TLS certificate reload workers clone shared source protobuf configuration;
  certificate selection/publication is synchronized, and OCSP/reload updates
  publish new certificate snapshots without mutating certificates already in
  use by handshakes. A concurrent reload regression verifies both properties.
- The upstream QUIC loopback test now waits on a completion channel instead
  of an unsynchronized shared bool. This is a test-only race correction.

Patch: LOCAL_CHANGES.patch (against the pristine tagged module).
End-to-end tests are run separately by the reconstructed project's proxy
package, including plain/encrypted XHTTP and Reality Vision loopback clients.
The broader offline package checks exclude TestECHDial and TestECHDialFail,
which require external Cloudflare/DNS service availability and are not local
reconstruction acceptance tests.

- Explicit configured legacy TLS suites also consult crypto/tls.InsecureCipherSuites, to support the supplied cipher-name/ID documentation; TLS defaults stay unchanged.
